;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Twelve people are killed and over 80 injured by two [[car bomb]]s at a gate outside police headquarters in [[Kandahar]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast/12-killed-scores-wounded-in-afghanistan-taliban-car-bombing-idUSKCN1UD1TZ?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**A [[suicide bombing]] kills two people in northern [[Sinai Peninsula|Sinai]] a day after four bodies were found [[decapitate]]d. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/07/killed-suicide-bombing-egypt-north-sinai-190718140314692.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] reports the [[United States Navy]]'s [[USS Boxer (LHD-4)|USS ''Boxer'']] "destroys" an [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] (IRGC) drone in a "defensive action", in the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. The Iranian drone reportedly came within {{convert|1000|yards|ft}} of the U.S. vessel and ignored multiple calls to stand down. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/07/18/trump-says-us-navy-shot-down-iranian-drone.html (CNBC)]

;International relations
*[[Iran]] confirms its seizure of a [[Panama|Panamanian]]-flagged oil tanker traveling from the [[United Arab Emirates]], and its 12 crewmembers, in the [[Persian Gulf]] last week. The tanker is being held at [[Qeshm Island]], and is accused by Iran of smuggling oil. The United Arab Emirates denies owning or operating the tanker. [https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/07/18/iran-seizes-oil-tanker-near-strait-hormuz-12-board/1764681001/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Argentina–Iran relations]]
**[[Ministry of Justice and Human Rights (Argentina)|Argentine Justice and Human Rights Minister]] [[Germán Garavano]] says that all countries are responsible to extradite the [[Iran|Iranian]] accused of the [[AMIA bombing]] to [[Argentina]] in case they ever set foot on their soil. [http://www.perspectivasur.com/3/82683-garavano-por-atentado-a-la-amia-la-deuda-de-la-justicia-todava-est-pendiente (Perspectiva Sur)]
*[[Holy See–Iran relations]]
**Cardinal [[Louis Raphaël I Sako|Louis Raphael Sako]], the head of the Iraq’s [[Chaldean Catholic Church]], voices his concerns about rising tensions between the [[Iran–United States relations|US and Iran]] could endanger plans for [[Pope Francis]] visit to Iraq. [http://www.asianews.it/news-en/For-Card-Sako,-US-Iran-tensions-threaten-papal-visit-to-Iraq-47558.html (Asia News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Kyoto Animation arson attack]]
**A 41-year-old man sets fire to the main offices of [[Kyoto Animation]], an animation studio based in [[Kyoto]], [[Japan]]. At least 34 people are confirmed dead and 35 injured. Many of the victims are in their 20s and 30s. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/18/dead-suspected-arson-attack-kyoto-animation-japan (''The Guardian'')]
